Cobots · rented + serviced nationwide

Cobots.

Collaborative robot arms that work safely next to people — handling the repetitive tasks that wear a line down.

A cobot is a collaborative robot arm built to work safely next to people — tending machines, packing, and handling the repetitive tasks that strain a line. Service Robot Co. rents the cobot, deploys it on your line, services it, and keeps a backup ready, across all 50 US states — so you automate a task without a capital purchase.

Request a quoteSee the lineup

Monthly rental — see rental pricing.

What it is

A cobot is a robot arm designed to share a workspace with people. Where a traditional industrial robot needs a cage, a cobot is built to work alongside your team on the same bench — tending a machine, packing a box, applying a label, or handling the repetitive motion that strains a worker over a shift. Manufacturers and packagers use it to take the dull, physical tasks off a line so people do the work that needs judgment.

Service Robot Co. owns the whole lifecycle. We pick the cobot that fits your task, deploy it on your line, set it up for the job, train your team, and keep it serviced — with a backup ready if one goes down. You rent an automated task, not a robotics engineering project.

What it does

Everything the unit does, in plain terms.

Works next to people

Built to share a bench with your team safely — no cage to engineer, so it fits an existing line.

Takes the repetitive task

Tends machines, packs, palletizes, and handles the dull, physical motion that wears a worker down over a shift.

Set up for your job

We configure it for the specific task during deployment, so it earns its keep from day one — not after a month of tuning.

Predictable monthly cost

Rent it by the month instead of buying. The service and the backup are on us, so a breakdown is not a stopped line.

Where it earns its keep

Machine tending

Load and unload a CNC, press, or molding machine so an operator runs several at once.

Packing & palletizing

Pack boxes and stack pallets at the end of a line without manual lifting.

Light assembly

Handle repetitive pick-place, fastening, and labeling steps next to your team.

Quality & inspection

Move parts through a check station on a consistent cycle.

How Service Robot Co. backs it

We don’t just hand you a box. We rent it, deploy it, service it, and back it up — so the robot stays field-ready, not shelf-ware.

We rent it

Take the robot on a monthly rental with no purchase and no capital tied up in a machine you use part-time.

We deploy it

On-site setup, route or task configuration, and a walkthrough so the robot earns its keep from day one — not after a month on the shelf.

We service it nationwide

Repairs, parts, and support across all 50 US states. A robot that breaks is our problem to fix, not your downtime to eat.

We back it up

If a unit goes down, we swap it. You keep your schedule; we carry the spare.

Specs

We match the exact unit and its specs to your site and your job. Tell us what you need and we’ll confirm the model, capabilities, and rental terms. Get the details.

Common questions

What is a cobot?
A cobot is a collaborative robot arm designed to work safely alongside people, without the cage a traditional industrial robot needs. It handles repetitive tasks — machine tending, packing, light assembly — next to your team on the same line.
Is a cobot safe to work next to?
Cobots are built to share a workspace with people. The right setup depends on your task and line, which we assess during deployment and configure for safe operation — we don’t hand you an arm and walk away.
Do we have to buy the cobot?
No. You rent it by the month. Service Robot Co. owns the cobot, deploys it, sets it up for your task, trains your team, services it, and keeps a backup — so the downtime risk stays with us.
Who maintains and supports it?
We do. Service, repairs, and a backup unit are part of every rental. You run the line; we keep the cobot field-ready.

Want one working for you?

Tell us the job and the site. We’ll match the cobots, quote the rental, walk your team through it, and keep it serviced.
